first_unsupported_edge.object_source: HippyDetailActivity.initListener allocates hippy.ui.detail.a, a subclass of H5JsApiScriptInterface; no JSONObject call argument and no invocation of showRankIntroduceDialog exists in the constructor
first_unsupported_edge.why_wrong: Subtype/superclass membership was treated as executable reachability. Constructing a subclass does not execute every inherited method, and therefore cannot transfer ownership to WebViews allocated by those methods.
first_unsupported_edge.actual_owner: The NewsWebView is field Lcom/tencent/news/ui/medal/view/dialog/c;->ˑˑ and belongs to the medal dialog instance created only on an actual showRankIntroduceDialog call; its unique Activity caller is not established by this evidence chain.

general_rule: Do not add arbitrary instance methods of a constructed object's superclass to the call graph. Require an invoke instruction or a modeled callback/reflective dispatch with matching selector and receiver.

first_unsupported_edge.reported_transition: SDK share call internal TDialog allocation/field -> TDialog WebView initialization
first_unsupported_edge.object_source: QQShare conditionally executes new TDialog(activity, ...).show() when the installed QQ version cannot perform native sharing; TDialog owns field Lcom/tencent/open/TDialog;->i:Lcom/tencent/open/d/b;
first_unsupported_edge.why_wrong: The application Activity is only a Context/launch parameter to an SDK call. Propagating Activity WebView ownership into every object allocated inside that SDK method confuses call reachability with receiver ownership; the WebView is stored on TDialog and is never returned to or stored by MobileQQActivity.
first_unsupported_edge.actual_owner: com.tencent.open.TDialog (SDK dialog); no manifest Activity owner for its internal WebView

general_rule: Across library calls, do not attribute callee-internal WebView allocations to a caller merely because the caller passes itself as Context/Activity. Require return flow, field assignment on the caller, view-tree attachment proved to the caller, or an explicit owned-wrapper contract.

first_unsupported_edge.why_wrong: Even if the SDK fallback call is control-flow valid, neither that edge nor the Activity parameter transfers ownership of the downstream TDialog field to QzoneShareActivity. The WebView has no return/field/view-tree path back to the application Activity.
first_unsupported_edge.actual_owner: com.tencent.open.TDialog (SDK dialog); no manifest Activity owner for its internal WebView

general_rule: Keep control reachability and ownership provenance separate through fallback/delegate chains. Context arguments are not ownership tokens; require a concrete backward object-flow path from the WebView receiver to an Activity-owned field, return, or attached view.
